stem.text: A stone is dropped from a tall building. Air resistance is significant. The variation of distance fallen with time is shown by the dashed line.
A second stone with the same dimensions but a smaller mass is dropped from the same building.
Which line represents the motion of the second stone?

stem.alt: Distance against time graph with a dashed line labelled path of first stone and four solid lines labelled A, B, C and D from the origin 0.
